Subject: Intro + request to schedule Redwood demo before our FY reset

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the intro last week — we've been hearing good things about Redwood from a couple of teams. We have a short window before our internal FY planning reset and a temporary spend freeze goes into effect next Monday.

Would your team be able to run a focused 30–45 minute demo this week so we can evaluate performance and economics before the freeze? Ideal windows for us are:
- Wed 4 Aug: 10:00–12:00 PT
- Thu 5 Aug: 14:00–16:00 PT
- Fri 6 Aug: 09:00–11:00 PT

Goal: demo core inference latency/cost controls, quick Q&A with engineering and procurement (if available). If those times won't work, we can also look at the week after the reset, but earlier would be helpful for budgeting.

I've CC'd our finance alias so procurement sees the ask.

Best,
Olivia Chen
Head of Data Platform
GreenVault Financial
